text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Among my birthday presents, there was a 
bouquet with no sender listed, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...The myriad vivid flowers were so fresh 
and lush, it felt as beautiful as a 
masterpiece painting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With that unmistakable dedication... they 
must have put serious thought into 
choosing it for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For my part, I would dearly love to speak 
in person and express my gratitude to the 
sender, who is so modest yet overflowing 
with sincerity and affection—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even if they are beautiful flowers— the 
words woven into them might not be a 
blessing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Do you intend to cast off your "Emperor's" 
crown and play the fool instead?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Harsh words. ...In that case, since I've 
already embarrassed myself, would you 
accept these words in their stead?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I said it was like a masterpiece, but... 
This bouquet—it looks a lot like the 
paintings you create.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the blessings. Thanks to 
you, I can forge ahead toward my ideal 
future this year as well.
